root.description: Absolute path to the top-level directory containing your media (videos, music, photos).

db.description: Path to persist the media database (optional). If empty, the database is in-memory and rebuilt on each start.

cache_dir.description: Path to store transcoding cache files (optional, improves performance).

interface.description: Network interface or IP to bind the HTTP and SSDP services to (e.g., 'eth0', '192.168.1.10', or '0.0.0.0' for all).

ssdp_port.description: UDP port used for SSDP/UPnP discovery announcements.

http.description: TCP port for the main HTTP server (serves media and transcoding streams).

ssdp_enabled.description: Whether to announce the server via UPnP/SSDP so clients can auto-discover it.

transcode_profile.description: Target format profile for transcoding. Common values: 'h264', 'webm', 'none'.

transcode_extra_args.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to FFmpeg during transcoding (e.g., ['-preset', 'fast']).

transcode_max_cores.description: Maximum CPU cores to use for transcoding. 0 = auto (use all cores).

log_file.description: Path to write logs (empty = log to stderr only).

device_name.description: Name of the DLNA device as displayed on UPnP clients.

device_model_name.description: UPnP model name (shown in device info).

device_model_url.description: URL for device documentation or support (optional).

mime_types.description: Custom MIME type mappings (e.g., {'mkv': 'video/x-matroska'}). Keys are lowercase file extensions (no dot).

items.description: MIME type for the file extension key.

file_filters_exclude.description: List of shell-style glob patterns for files or directories to skip (e.g., ['.hidden', '*.tmp']).

thumbnails_enabled.description: Enable generation of embedded video thumbnails (requires FFmpeg).
